keyword.zh: 电动40和电动30混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 电动40和电动30混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Electric 30 prints 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h and fine-stone 60 m / 180 m. Electric 40 prints 45 kW, 21 m³/h and fine-stone 120 m / 360 m.
description.zh: 电动30印 30 kW、12–15 m³/h、细石 60 m / 180 m。电动40印 45 kW、21 m³/h、细石 120 m / 360 m。

h1.zh: 电动40和电动30混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 30 and Electric 40 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 30 prints 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, fine-stone 60 m / 180 m, aggregate-13 20 m / 60 m and aggregate ≤ 3 cm. Electric 40 prints 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, fine-stone 120 m / 360 m and aggregate-13 40 m / 120 m, plus Kawasaki 112. Electric 40 does not print a separate maximum-aggregate cell.
directAnswer.zh: 电动30和电动40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动30印 30 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、细石 60 m / 180 m、13骨料 20 m / 60 m、骨料 ≤ 3 cm。电动40印 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、细石 120 m / 360 m、13骨料 40 m / 120 m，以及川崎112。电动40没有单独的最大骨料格。

heading.en: Where Electric 40 and Electric 30 print different values
heading.zh: 电动40和电动30哪些数值不同

body.en: Motor power: Electric 40 prints 45 kW; Electric 30 prints 30 kW. Theoretical output: Electric 40 prints 21 m³/h; Electric 30 prints 12–15 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 40 prints 23 MPa; Electric 30 prints 20 MPa. Hopper capacity: Electric 40 prints 0.4 m³; Electric 30 prints 0.3 m³. Fine-stone pumping (H / V): Electric 40 prints 120 m / 360 m; Electric 30 prints 60 m / 180 m. Aggregate-13 pumping (H / V): Electric 40 prints 40 m / 120 m; Electric 30 prints 20 m / 60 m. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动40印 45 kW；电动30印 30 kW。理论输送量：电动40印 21 m³/h；电动30印 12–15 m³/h。最大出口压力：电动40印 23 MPa；电动30印 20 MPa。料斗容积：电动40印 0.4 m³；电动30印 0.3 m³。细石输送（水平/垂直）：电动40印 120 m / 360 m；电动30印 60 m / 180 m。13骨料输送（水平/垂直）：电动40印 40 m / 120 m；电动30印 20 m / 60 m。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 40 prints cells that Electric 30 does not: Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 112. Electric 30 prints cells that Electric 40 does not: Max. aggregate size ≤ 3 cm. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动40有、电动30没有的行：液压泵 Kawasaki 112。电动30有、电动40没有的行：最大骨料粒径 ≤ 3 cm。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: The fine-stone pair grows from 60 m / 180 m to 120 m / 360 m, and it still belongs to the page where it is printed. Open /en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/ for Electric 40 and /en/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/ for Electric 30. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 细石数对从 60 m / 180 m 变为 120 m / 360 m，数字仍然只属于印出它的那一页。看电动40请打开 /zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/，看电动30请打开 /zh/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 40 print the same motor power as Electric 30?
question.zh: 电动40和电动30的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 prints 45 kW. Electric 30 prints 30 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40印 45 kW。电动30印 30 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 40 print the same theoretical output as Electric 30?
question.zh: 电动40和电动30的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 prints 21 m³/h. Electric 30 prints 12–15 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40印 21 m³/h。电动30印 12–15 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 40 print the same max. outlet pressure as Electric 30?
question.zh: 电动40和电动30的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 prints 23 MPa. Electric 30 prints 20 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40印 23 MPa。电动30印 20 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is hydraulic pump missing on Electric 30?
question.zh: 为什么电动30没有液压泵？

answer.en: The Electric 30 page does not print that label. Electric 40 prints Kawasaki 112. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动30这一页没有印这个标题。电动40印的是 Kawasaki 112。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
